//: Fighting stances (07 §12): traits of one group, so that taking one leaves the other. A stance is what it confers and the rules it carries: nothing in the engine knows aggression from caution. Values are illustrative.
name: Aggressive
description: Pressing in, every blow thrown hard.

//: Guarded: a little less behind each blow, and every blow noticed in time is met with a block, on a shield if one is held and on the forearm if not.
name: Defensive

//: Taking a stance, or another one (07 §12): the trait is given as the shift ends, and the other of its group goes.
name: Take a stance

//: Where a blow is aimed when nobody says (07 §3.1, §4.2): at no part in particular, so that it lands where the body offers.
doc: The part a blow is aimed at when none is chosen: none, so that it lands where the target's body offers it (07 §4.2).

//: How hard a blow is thrown when nobody says (07 §3.3): all of it, unless a stance says otherwise. The actions give it what their actor knows of itself: whether it stands guarded.
doc: The effort of a blow when none is chosen (07 §3.3): full effort, or seven tenths for someone guarded (in a defensive stance). Safe for belief.

//: Being badly staggered (07 §7) breaks off a blow under way.
doc: A push that staggers someone at half the way to launching them or more interrupts the blows they have under way (actions tagged `strike`). Off when the setting `core:staggering` is false.
